Method of Attack: Malvertising via compromised ad server delivering a fake GIF with embedded JavaScript redirecting to the GreenFlash Sundown exploit kit; Exploit kit attempts Flash exploit, then executes PowerShell command to check for virtual machine and installs ransomware, miner, and information stealing Trojan
Impacted Systems: Windows systems vulnerable to Flash exploit
Attack Vector: Compromised ad server on onlinevideoconverter.com serving malicious ads
Indicators of Compromise: Fake GIF file with embedded JavaScript
